title: fix(app-shell): offer Sync objects only on a federation-source datasource
body:
Fixes #13318

Clause-②: no

## What changes

Setup → Datasources showed **Sync objects** on every datasource row. Since objectstack#24837 (merged as objectstack `72a302a9d`), every Sync door refuses a datasource that is not a federation source with a `400`: a `managed` one, declared or by default, and the platform's `default` datasource by name. On such a row the button opened a dialog that could only show the refusal.

`DatasourceResourcePage` now renders the existing button only when `offersSync(row)` holds: the row's `schemaMode`, read from the `GET /api/v1/datasources` payload the page already holds, is `external` or `validate-only`, and the row is not `default`. Nothing else changes: no new widget, dialog, hook, request or locale key.

- `DatasourceRow` declares `schemaMode`, typed with the spec's own `SchemaMode` (`@objectstack/spec/data`).
- The `default` name is a literal beside a comment naming the server's `DEFAULT_DATASOURCE_NAME`: that constant lives in `@objectstack/service-datasource`, a server package the console does not depend on, and the spec does not export it.

## The card's acceptance, met

From the card's **Expected**:

> The Sync action is offered only on a row whose `schemaMode` is `external` or `validate-only`, read from the list payload the page already holds.

Met: `offersSync` is an allow-list over the row's own `schemaMode`.

> A missing `schemaMode` reads as `managed`: the spec's default, and the editor's own reading.

Met without a fallback: a missing value is not in the allow-list, so it offers no Sync. (The server's list summary already serves `schemaMode: effective.schemaMode ?? 'managed'` on every row, at objectui's objectstack pin `06cab4849` and at objectstack `origin/main`.)

> On a managed row nothing starts a Sync. If the row says anything, it names the remedy the server's refusal names [...]

Met by hiding the button: nothing starts a Sync, and the row says nothing. A disabled button with a native tooltip was not chosen: the Button primitive's disabled state sets `pointer-events-none`, so the tooltip would not show without a new wrapper. The remedy stays the editor's existing Schema mode select.

> The platform's `default` datasource offers no Sync either; the server already refuses it by name.

Met: `offersSync` refuses the name first, whatever its `schemaMode`.

> No new widget, dialog or hook: the existing button's visibility or disabled state, and the existing editor.

Met: the existing button's visibility only.

From the card's **Pins**, in the new `DatasourceResourcePage.syncFederationOnly-13318.test.tsx`:

- (a) a row with no `schemaMode` and a `managed` row show no Sync button (both rows render their Test button);
- (b) an `external` row and a `validate-only` row show it;
- (c) the `default` row shows none, even declared `external`;
- (d) CONTROL: on an `external` row, Sync opens the dialog, requests `GET /api/v1/datasources/warehouse/remote-tables`, and lists the remote tables.

Fixture triage: the objectui#13207 suite (`DatasourceResourcePage.refusals-13207.test.tsx`) drove Sync on a `managed` row. Its row now declares `external`: its refusal cases pin how a refused introspection is drawn, which still applies to a federation source (an unreachable driver, say), and `managed` was incidental.

## Measured premises

- The list payload carries `schemaMode`: `DatasourceAdminService.listDatasources` sets it on every summary, and the contract `DatasourceSummary.schemaMode` is required, at the pin `06cab4849` and at objectstack `origin/main`. No new request.
- The pin does not need to move: the console reads the row's own `schemaMode`. `git merge-base --is-ancestor 72a302a9d origin/main` in the objectstack checkout answers exit 0.
- The server's guard is `ExternalDatasourceService.assertFederationSource`: the `default` name first, then `isFederationSource` (a declared `schemaMode` that is not `managed`).

## Verification (head `46bd4f4`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/datasource/`: Test Files 4 passed (4), Tests 27 passed (27).
- Narrowed app-shell set (the datasource directory, `packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/`, and three tree-wide ratchet/census tests): Test Files 31 passed (31), Tests 488 passed (488). The full app-shell suite (1674 test files) is left to CI.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists both datasource test files the diff touches.
- Ablation, one run: `{offersSync(ds) && (` replaced with `{true && (` through `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `1ef26d74d6e7` to `2c02bcdbca5f`): pins (a) and (c) went red, (b) and (d) stayed green, Tests 2 failed, 25 passed. Restored: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` over the datasource directory: 0 errors; 2 warnings, both on lines this diff does not touch.
- `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, the three `check:vi-mock-*`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:spec-symbols`: exit 0 each. `check-governed-queue-guard --test` on the diff: NOT GOVERNED.

## Acceptance notes

- The page header still reads "Connect external databases and sync their tables in as objects." It is still true of the page and was left alone.
- Changeset: `.changeset/13318-datasource-sync-managed.md`, `@object-ui/app-shell` patch.
